newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Australia blocks WTO panel in Canada salmon row.
newsitem.headline: Australia blocks WTO panel in Canada salmon row.

text.p: Australia on Thursday refused to agree to a request from Canada for quick creation of a World Trade Organisation panel to look into their dispute over imports of Canadian salmon.
But a panel, which will have six months to come up with a ruling, will be automatically set up on April 30 at the next meeting of the WTO's Dispute Settlement Body (DSB).
Canada argues that an Australian import ban based on quarantine regulations dating back to 1975 violates WTO open trading accords.
Australia does not contest that it has stringent quarantine regulations but insists these are consistent with WTO rules.
It argues that the two sides should engage in further bilateral consultations on a salmon import risk analysis carried out by Australian scientists last December.

The United States has also complained to the WTO over the Australian restrictions. It told the DSB on Thursday it shared Canada's concerns but was still talking to Canberra in an effort to find a settlement.
